summary: OS Therapies filed an 8-K under Items 8.01/9.01 on September 10, 2026, disclosing a prospectus supplement to its Form S-3 (File No. 333-289443, effective August 25, 2025) covering resale of up to 5,874,094 common shares by selling stockholders, including 600,000 shares, 900,000 pre-funded warrant shares, and 1,500,000 warrant shares. The filing provides counsel Olshan Frome Wolosky's legality opinion as Exhibit 5.1. This is a routine shelf takedown and resale registration, not a special situation; no price, premium, board recommendation, or structural terms are stated, and no deal timetable or risk-arb angle applies.
